verdict.rationale: Vercel documents environment and variable management across local, preview, production, and custom environments. It also documents team/project-scoped access tokens, identity-provider-based protection, and Owner/Member/Viewer seat roles, which together cover parts of centralized access and configuration. However, the evidence does not show team-level shared environment variables, dedicated secret handling such as encryption, sensitive-value masking or rotation, or a central role-based access admin console. missing for 10: team-wide (cross-project) shared env vars/secrets, explicit secret encryption/rotation controls, detailed RBAC/permission management docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
Every token carries a scope that determines which resources it can reach
Secure every internal agent, app, and deployment with your identity provider.
Seats with Owner or Member roles: $20/month each. These team seats have the ability to configure & deploy projects. Viewer Pro (read-only) seats: Free.
